# packages/force-bench/src/force_bench/appendix_tasks/common.py
APPENDIX_OUT = OUTPUTS_ROOT / "appendix_tasks"

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

and 3 (`_2`, `_3`) and bottle 1 with the 4-revolution thread (`_4rev`). The cap starts in the hand just above the

strokes until it stalls on the bottle's lip, lets go and moves away.

APPENDIX_OUT = OUTPUTS_ROOT / "appendix_tasks"

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

initial_conditions:
charging block held above the outlet

Source-authored setup notes
The charger starts in the hand with its prongs just above the outlet. `plug_in_charger` uses the original
charger; `plug_in_charger_block1` ... `4` use the kit's four charging blocks with the kit outlet's softest printed
spring (0.4 mm indent). `plug_in_charger_block1_spring_0.85mm` uses the stiffer 0.85 mm spring, the paper's
insertion-force variation: the grasp slips part-way in, so the robot presses the block home from its top, as a person
would with a thumb. After seating, the robot pushes again to check that the charger does not move, lets go and moves
away.

Row arguments
["--block", "1"]
source_note: This is a simulation-release row with a privileged scripted reference, rather than a learned-policy evaluation result. The source documents physical-model and starting-state differences from the paper. Website task identifiers are not assumed to equal the Table C1 number.
task_options: `--spring 0.4 | 0.7 | 0.85 | 1` selects the outlet's printed spring.
documented_differences:
The printed contact springs are modelled as sprung pads in the blade slots, fitted to the measured
insertion force of the 0.4 and 0.85 mm springs; the 0.7 and 1 mm springs are interpolated and extrapolated from
them. The blocks' masses are estimates from their printed volume.

def verdict(rig, sc, ex, log, paths, extra_criteria=None, task_title="Place card into holder",
            changes=None, source="new task (no suite counterpart); reverse of "
                                 "force_bench.tasks.card_pick, finalized-kit holder and cards",
            transport_from=None, extra_pen=None, envelope=None):
    qa = rig.qa(paths)
    d = np.load(paths["states"], allow_pickle=True)
    bq, t = d["body_q"], d["t"]
    labels = list(d["body_labels"])
    fps = rig.fps
    inew = labels.index(sc.new)
    deck_ids = [labels.index(l) for l in sc.deck]
    tph = ex.t_start
    t_end = float(t[-1])
    fin = t >= t_end - T_STILL + 0.2

    def speed_mm_s(i, m):
        cc = np.array([C.card_corners(bq[f, i]) for f in np.flatnonzero(m)])
        if len(cc) < 2:
            return 0.0
        return float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(cc, axis=0), axis=-1).max() * fps * MM)

    crit = dict(extra_criteria or {})
    i7 = labels.index("fr3/fr3_link7")
    t_rel = ex.events.get("release_t")

    def in_hand(f):
        """Card origin in the link7 frame (the pinch's own frame)."""
        return (np.linalg.inv(world_T(bq[f, i7])) @ world_T(bq[f, inew]))[:3, 3]

    # ── held in hand at the start, and through the transport ─────────────
    th0 = tph.get("hold", 0.0)
    th1 = tph.get("carry", th0 + T_HOLD) if transport_from is None else float(transport_from)
    pL, pR = log.arr("padL"), log.arr("padR")
    lt = log.arr("t")
    lm = (lt >= th0 + 0.1) & (lt < th1)
    hf = np.flatnonzero((t >= th0) & (t < th1))
    ih = np.array([in_hand(f) for f in hf])
    sink = float(np.linalg.norm(ih - in_hand(0), axis=1).max()) if len(ih) else 9.9
    both = float(((pL[lm] > 0.5) & (pR[lm] > 0.5)).mean()) if lm.any() else 0.0
    env = float((log.arr("holder") + log.arr("deck") + log.arr("table"))[lm].max()) if lm.any() else 0.0
    if "hold" in tph:
        crit["held_in_hand_at_start"] = {
            "pass": bool(sink < 0.0005 and both >= 0.95 and env < 0.01),
            "card_slip_in_pinch_during_hold_mm": round(sink * MM, 3),
            "both_pads_loaded_fraction": round(both, 3),
            "pad_mean_N": [round(float(pL[lm].mean()), 2), round(float(pR[lm].mean()), 2)],
            "other_contact_max_N": round(env, 4),
            "window_s": [round(th0, 2), round(th1, 2)],
            "note": "the card starts pinched (pads on its faces at t = 0, no pre-roll); over "
                    "the hold it moves < 0.5 mm in the hand's own frame, both pads carry it "
                    "and nothing else touches it"}
    if t_rel is not None:
        tf = np.flatnonzero((t >= th1) & (t < t_rel))
        tr = np.array([in_hand(f) for f in tf])
        slip_tr = float(np.linalg.norm(tr - tr[0], axis=1).max()) if len(tr) else 9.9
        mt = (lt >= th1) & (lt < t_rel)
        both_tr = float(((pL[mt] > 0.5) & (pR[mt] > 0.5)).mean()) if mt.any() else 0.0
        crit["held_through_transport"] = {
            "pass": bool(slip_tr < 0.001 and both_tr >= 0.98),
            "card_slip_in_pinch_mm": round(slip_tr * MM, 3),
            "both_pads_loaded_fraction": round(both_tr, 3),
            "pad_min_N": [round(float(pL[mt].min()), 2), round(float(pR[mt].min()), 2)],
            "window_s": [round(th1, 2), round(float(t_rel), 2)],
            "note": "carry, align and descent: the card is carried by the two pads only "
                    "(no joint, weld or kinematic attachment exists in this scene) and moves "
                    "< 1 mm in the hand's frame until the release"}
    # ── released inside the slot ────────────────────────────────────────
    if t_rel is not None:
        fr = int(np.argmin(np.abs(t - t_rel)))
        sl = C.in_slot(bq[fr, inew])
        low = float(C.card_corners(bq[fr, inew])[:, 2].min())
        top = float(C.card_corners(bq[fr, inew], C.BOTTOM_CORNERS)[:, 2].max())
        lows = np.array([C.card_corners(bq[f, inew])[:, 2].min() for f in range(fr, len(t))])
        f_land = fr + int(np.argmax(lows <= C.FLOOR_Z + 0.0002)) if (lows <= C.FLOOR_Z + 0.0002).any() else None
        v_land = (float(np.linalg.norm(bq[f_land, inew, :3] - bq[f_land - 1, inew, :3]) * fps)
                  if f_land else None)
        crit["released_inside_slot"] = {
            "pass": bool(sl["bottom_corners_inside_walls_x"] and sl["bottom_corners_inside_end_walls_y"]
                         and top < C.WALL_TOP_Z),
            "release_t_s": round(float(t_rel), 2), **sl,
            "lower_edge_z_mm": [round(low * MM, 2), round(top * MM, 2)],
            "wall_top_z_mm": C.WALL_TOP_Z * MM,
            "fall_to_floor_mm": round((low - C.FLOOR_Z) * MM, 2),
            "landed_on_floor_t_s": round(float(t[f_land]), 3) if f_land else None,
            "landing_speed_m_s": round(v_land, 3) if v_land is not None else None,
            "release_trigger": ex.events.get("why"),
            "deck_side_tip_above_deck_mm": ex.events.get("tip_above_deck_mm"),
            "note": "the pads open with the card's whole lower edge already inside the slot "
                    "(between the side walls and end walls, below the side-wall tops); a "
                    "face pinch keeps one fingertip between the card and the deck, so the "
                    "last few mm are the card sliding down the front card's face"}
    else:
        crit["released_inside_slot"] = {"pass": False, "note": "never released"}
    # ── the placed card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    sl = C.in_slot(bq[-1, inew])
    lean_new = C.card_lean_deg(bq[-1, inew])
    lean_front = C.card_lean_deg(bq[-1, deck_ids[-1]])
    cf, Rf, nf, uf = C.card_frame(bq[-1, deck_ids[-1]])
    cn = bq[-1, inew, :3]
    face_gap = float((cn - cf) @ nf) - C.CARD_T
    v_new = speed_mm_s(inew, fin)
    deck_contact = float(log.arr("deck")[log.arr("t") >= t_end - T_STILL + 0.2].mean())
    on_floor = abs(sl["lowest_point_above_floor_mm"]) <= 0.5
    in_walls = sl["bottom_corners_inside_walls_x"] and sl["bottom_corners_inside_end_walls_y"]
    stacked = abs(lean_new - lean_front) < 3.0 and abs(face_gap) < 0.0006
    crit["card_in_holder"] = {
        "pass": bool(in_walls and on_floor and stacked and v_new < 2.0),
        **sl, "on_floor": bool(on_floor),
        "lean_deg": round(lean_new, 2), "front_card_lean_deg": round(lean_front, 2),
        "face_gap_to_front_card_mm": round(face_gap * MM, 3),
        "card_on_deck_contact_mean_N": round(deck_contact, 4),
        "weight_N": round(9.81 * C.card_mass(), 4),
        "final_speed_mm_s": round(v_new, 3),
        "final_centre_mm": [round(float(v) * MM, 2) for v in cn],
        "note": "final window: all four bottom corners inside the slot's side walls and end "
                "walls, the lowest point on the floor (+-0.5 mm), leaning in the stack (lean "
                "within 3 deg of the front card's, face gap < 0.6 mm), at rest (< 2 mm/s)"}
    # ── the existing cards ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    others, ok_o = {}, True
    for l, i in zip(sc.deck, deck_ids):
        disp = float(np.linalg.norm(bq[-1, i, :3] - bq[0, i, :3]))
        dmax = float(np.linalg.norm(bq[:, i, :3] - bq[0, i, :3], axis=1).max())
        n0 = C.card_frame(bq[0, i])[2]
        n1 = C.card_frame(bq[-1, i])[2]
        tilt = float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(abs(n0 @ n1), -1, 1))))
        s_ = C.in_slot(bq[-1, i])
        v_ = speed_mm_s(i, fin)
        ok = (disp < 0.003 and tilt < 3.0 and s_["bottom_corners_inside_walls_x"]
              and s_["bottom_corners_inside_end_walls_y"]
              and abs(s_["lowest_point_above_floor_mm"]) <= 0.5 and v_ < 2.0)
        others[l] = {"final_disp_mm": round(disp * MM, 3), "max_disp_mm": round(dmax * MM, 3),
                     "tilt_change_deg": round(tilt, 3), "lean_deg_final": round(C.card_lean_deg(bq[-1, i]), 2),
                     "final_speed_mm_s": round(v_, 3), **s_, "pass": bool(ok)}
        ok_o &= ok
    crit["existing_cards_remain"] = {
        "pass": bool(ok_o), "cards": others, "max_disp_mm": 3.0, "max_tilt_deg": 3.0,
        "note": "every pre-loaded card ends within 3 mm / 3 deg of its start, inside the slot, "
                "on its floor and at rest"}
    # ── released and clear, robot stopped ───────────────────────────────
    if t_rel is not None:
        i_rel = int(np.searchsorted(lt, t_rel))
        tcp = np.column_stack([log.arr("tcp_x"), log.arr("tcp_y"), log.arr("tcp_z")])
        moved = float(np.linalg.norm(tcp[-1] - tcp[i_rel]))
    else:
        moved = 0.0
    t_from = tph.get("still", t_end - T_STILL)
    check_released_and_clear(qa, lt, log.arr("robot_obj"), t_from, extra={
        "tcp_moved_from_release_mm": round(moved * MM, 1), "min_move_mm": 50.0})
    rel = qa.report["checks"]["released_and_clear"]
    rel["pass"] = bool(rel["pass"] and moved >= 0.050)
    crit["released_and_clear"] = rel
    arm_ix = [i for i, l in enumerate(labels) if str(l).startswith("fr3/")]
    m = t >= t_end - T_STILL + 0.2
    v_arm = float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(bq[m][:, arm_ix, :3], axis=0), axis=-1).max()) * fps
    crit["robot_stopped"] = {"pass": bool(v_arm < 0.005),
                             "max_link_speed_final_window_mm_s": round(v_arm * MM, 3),
                             "threshold_mm_s": 5.0}
    # ── physics integrity: penetration + envelope ───────────────────────
    cards = list(sc.deck) + [sc.new]
    n_f = len(t)
    frames = set(np.linspace(0, n_f - 1, 36).astype(int).tolist())
    if t_rel is not None:
        f0 = int(np.searchsorted(t, t_rel))
        frames |= set(range(f0, min(n_f, f0 + int(1.2 * fps)), 3))
    frames = sorted(frames)
    pairs = C.audit_cards(bq, t, labels, cards, sc.holder_tm, sc.holder_raw, frames)
    if extra_pen is not None:
        pairs.update(extra_pen(bq, t, labels, frames))
    for k_, v_ in pairs.items():
        print(f"  audit {k_}: {v_['max_depth_mm']:+.3f} mm at t={v_['at_t']}")
    ok_pen = all(v["pass"] for v in pairs.values())
    qa.report["checks"]["penetration"] = {
        "pass": bool(ok_pen), "tolerance_mm": 0.8, "pairs": pairs, "frames_checked": len(frames),
        "note": "ground truth: card box surfaces (1.5 mm grid) vs the CAD holder mesh with "
                "ray-verified inside sign, CAD holder vertices vs each card box, every card "
                "pair exactly (box vs box points), both directions"}
    qa.report["pass"] &= bool(ok_pen)
    lo_e, hi_e = envelope or ([-0.20, -0.20, -0.002], [0.25, 0.25, 0.30])
    qa.check_envelope(cards, lo_e, hi_e)
    qa.report["checks"]["expert_tracking"] = {
        "pass": True, "info_only": True, "events": ex.events,
        "phase_start_s": {k: round(v, 2) for k, v in tph.items()},
        "peak_joint_cmd_step_rad": round(ex.trk.dq_peak, 4),
        "card_servo_corr_final_mm": np.round(ex.corr * MM, 2).tolist()}
    for k_, c_ in crit.items():
        qa.report["checks"].setdefault(k_, c_)
    qa.report["pass"] = all(c.get("pass", True) for c in qa.report["checks"].values())
    report = rig.finish(qa)
    return save_appendix_verdict(
        rig, task=task_title, source=source,
        spec="The robot movement stops after placing the card in the card holder, with "
             "existing cards remaining in the card holder. The robot should not remain in "
             "contact with the task objects.",
        criteria=crit, physics_qa=report,
        changes=changes or [
            "new task: finalized-kit holder (assets/bodies_kit/card_holder_kit) with 3 kit "
            "cards leaning at 12 deg on its far bracket posts; a 4th kit card starts pinched "
            "in the FR3's hand, vertical, 7.5 cm to the free side",
            "the card is carried, turned to the deck's measured lean, aligned in the slot "
            "(0.75 mm of end play) and lowered down the deck plane in front of the front card; "
            "the pads open with its lower edge inside the slot ~9 mm above the floor (the "
            "deck-side fingertip has to stay above the deck), and it slides onto the floor",
            "cards are analytic boxes on analytic slot supports matching the CAD faces "
            "(tasks/card_pick's model); the CAD holder collides with the robot and is the "
            "penetration ground truth",
        ])

APPENDIX_OUT = OUTPUTS_ROOT / "appendix_tasks"

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

Source-authored setup notes
As in the real-world video: the kit's black 5-port shell lies on its side with its ports facing up, a grey
printed insert in every port, and the white printed plug, without a cable, starts in the hand above the port farthest
from the camera. The plug's printed latch tab springs down as it passes the insert's lips and catches behind them. The
robot inserts the plug, pulls it lightly without touching the tab (the latch must hold it), lets go and moves away.

  force is somewhat higher.

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

The kit's four USB sticks and its USB slot, standing with its mouth up. The slot's printed spring jaws

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}

        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min

    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel

    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")

             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),

Source-authored setup notes
The kit's four USB sticks and its USB slot, standing with its mouth up. The slot's printed spring jaws
grip the inserted stick; `plug_in_usb_1` ... `4` use the softest spring (0.2 mm indent), the `_spring04` and
`_spring06` rows the stiffer 0.4 and 0.6 mm springs. The stick starts in the hand above the slot, slightly off its
axis. The robot aligns it, inserts it, pushes again to check that it does not move, lets go and moves away.

simulation_differences: the slot's printed spring jaws are prismatic joint drives at an estimated 66 N/mm per jaw (finite-element model of the printed flexure; no force measurement exists); the stick carries a 15 g conditioning mass (print estimate 1.5-5.6 g) and the jaw contacts are stiffened, so that MuJoCo's contact is stiffer than the jaws; pinch 24 N per pad (12 N on the 0.2 mm spring)
task_options:
`--seed N` places the slot anywhere in the paper's 0.15 × 0.15 m square, turned by up to ±20°;
`--offset-mm X,Y` sets the stick's start offset from the slot's axis.
documented_differences:
The jaws' stiffness is an estimate from a model of the printed flexure, not a measurement. The sticks
are heavier than the prints (15 g instead of 1.5 to 5.6 g) to keep their contact stable in the solver.

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:

    return ok

    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:

                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):

        "appendix_task": task,

        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),

    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,

        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

The kit's three dials, each with the flat (wing) knob or the round knob:

- snap-to-position dial (`_snap`, `_snap_round`): a detent every 60°; target 120°.

must hold), then presses, turns to the target, lets go and moves away.

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

Source-authored setup notes
The kit's three dials, each with the flat (wing) knob or the round knob:

- push-down dial (`turn_dial_to_target`, `_round`): locked at 0° until it is pressed down about 3 mm; target 90°;
- standard dial (`_standard`, `_standard_round`): a friction brake holds any angle; target 90°;
- snap-to-position dial (`_snap`, `_snap_round`): a detent every 60°; target 120°.

The open hand closes on the knob. On the push-down dial the robot first tries to turn it without pressing (the lock
must hold), then presses, turns to the target, lets go and moves away.

printed material, not measured. The snap dial's detents do not centre the knob by themselves, so the robot trims onto
the target detent. The pressed push-down knob turns with somewhat less torque than estimated (about 0.19 N·m instead
of 0.28 N·m).

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],

    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:

        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

Source-authored setup notes
The kit's three dials, each with the flat (wing) knob or the round knob:

- push-down dial (`turn_dial_to_target`, `_round`): locked at 0° until it is pressed down about 3 mm; target 90°;
- standard dial (`_standard`, `_standard_round`): a friction brake holds any angle; target 90°;
- snap-to-position dial (`_snap`, `_snap_round`): a detent every 60°; target 120°.

The open hand closes on the knob. On the push-down dial the robot first tries to turn it without pressing (the lock
must hold), then presses, turns to the target, lets go and moves away.

    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

initial_conditions:
snap-to-position dial at position 0, open hand around the round knob

Source-authored setup notes
The kit's three dials, each with the flat (wing) knob or the round knob:

- push-down dial (`turn_dial_to_target`, `_round`): locked at 0° until it is pressed down about 3 mm; target 90°;
- standard dial (`_standard`, `_standard_round`): a friction brake holds any angle; target 90°;
- snap-to-position dial (`_snap`, `_snap_round`): a detent every 60°; target 120°.

The open hand closes on the knob. On the push-down dial the robot first tries to turn it without pressing (the lock
must hold), then presses, turns to the target, lets go and moves away.

Row arguments
["--dial", "snap", "--knob", "round"]
source_note: This is a simulation-release row with a privileged scripted reference, rather than a learned-policy evaluation result. The source documents physical-model and starting-state differences from the paper. Website task identifiers are not assumed to equal the Table C1 number.
simulation_differences: the printed springs are sprung contact bodies with stiffnesses estimated from the CAD (finite-element and beam models, not measured); the knob rides a joint that carries the CAD's sub-0.3 mm running fits; the printed detents do not self-centre (PLA friction), so the policy trims onto the target detent
simulation_checks:
`dial_at_target` (within 7.5°; the snap dial seated in the target detent), `dial_stays_after_release`,
`unpressed_try_blocked` and `held_down_off_zero` (push-down dial), `finger_grasp_real`, `released_and_clear`.
task_options:
`--set "Target position=<degrees>"` sets another target (any 15° tick; the snap dial's 60° positions);
`--seed N` places the dial anywhere in the paper's 0.15 × 0.15 m square, turned by up to ±15°.
documented_differences:
The dials' printed springs and brake pads are modelled with stiffnesses estimated from the CAD and the
printed material, not measured. The snap dial's detents do not centre the knob by themselves, so the robot trims onto
the target detent. The pressed push-down knob turns with somewhat less torque than estimated (about 0.19 N·m instead
of 0.28 N·m).

# packages/force-bench/src/force_bench/appendix_tasks/common.py
APPENDIX_OUT = OUTPUTS_ROOT / "appendix_tasks"

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

# packages/force-bench/src/force_bench/appendix_tasks/common.py
APPENDIX_OUT = OUTPUTS_ROOT / "appendix_tasks"

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

Every task's variation axes, random starts and other options are listed by `force-bench variations` and
`force-bench info <name>`, and described in [variations.md](variations.md):

```bash
force-bench run plug_in_charger_block1 --set "Insertion force=0.85mm"   # a variation value, by its website label
```

A run with `--set`, `--seed` or `--embodiment` writes to its own folder, `outputs/appendix_tasks/<name>__<choices>/`,

# packages/force-bench/src/force_bench/appendix_tasks/common.py
APPENDIX_OUT = OUTPUTS_ROOT / "appendix_tasks"

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

`force-bench info <name>`, and described in [variations.md](variations.md):

```bash
force-bench run plug_in_charger_block1 --set "Insertion force=0.85mm"   # a variation value, by its website label
```

A run with `--set`, `--seed` or `--embodiment` writes to its own folder, `outputs/appendix_tasks/<name>__<choices>/`,

# packages/force-bench/src/force_bench/appendix_tasks/common.py
APPENDIX_OUT = OUTPUTS_ROOT / "appendix_tasks"

CONTACT_FREE_N = 0.05

def check_released_and_clear(qa, t, contact_N, t_from: float, *, name="released_and_clear",
                             tcp_z=None, tcp_rise_min=None, extra: dict | None = None) -> bool:
    """The appendix's "moving away from, and breaking contact with the task
    objects": over [t_from, end] the summed robot<->object contact force
    stays below CONTACT_FREE_N."""
    t = np.asarray(t, float)
    f = np.asarray(contact_N, float)
    m = t >= t_from
    peak = float(f[m].max()) if m.any() else float("inf")
    ok = bool(m.any() and peak < CONTACT_FREE_N)
    entry = {"pass": ok, "window_s": [round(float(t_from), 2), round(float(t[-1]), 2)],
             "robot_object_contact_peak_N": round(peak, 4),
             "threshold_N": CONTACT_FREE_N}
    if tcp_z is not None and tcp_rise_min is not None:
        rise = float(np.asarray(tcp_z)[-1] - np.asarray(tcp_z)[m][0]) if m.any() else 0.0
        entry["tcp_moved_away_mm"] = round(rise * 1000, 1)
        entry["min_move_mm"] = round(tcp_rise_min * 1000, 1)
        ok = ok and rise >= tcp_rise_min
        entry["pass"] = bool(ok)
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    qa.report["checks"][name] = entry
    qa.report["pass"] &= ok
    return ok

def save_appendix_verdict(rig, *, task: str, source: str, spec: str,
                          criteria: dict[str, dict], changes: list[str],
                          physics_qa: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write appendix_qa.json: the appendix criterion, item by item.

    criteria: {name: {"pass": bool, ...measurements}}; the verdict is the
    AND of the criteria and of the physics QA's integrity checks (finite,
    velocity, penetration, envelope, and with GelSight pads the three gel
    checks) when given."""
    # the published criterion (paper Table C1, verbatim) replaces the module's own wording of it
    from force_bench.appendix_tasks.registry import BY_NAME, CRITERIA
    row = BY_NAME.get(Path(rig.out_dir).name)
    if row is not None and row.number in CRITERIA:
        spec = CRITERIA[row.number]
    integrity = {}
    if physics_qa is not None:
        for k in ("finite", "velocity_spikes", "penetration", "workspace_envelope",
                  "gel_pads_loaded", "gel_coulomb_bounded", "gel_probe_crosscheck"):
            if k in physics_qa.get("checks", {}):
                integrity[k] = bool(physics_qa["checks"][k]["pass"])
    ok = all(bool(c.get("pass")) for c in criteria.values()) and all(integrity.values())
    out = {
        "appendix_task": task,
        "derived_from": source,
        "appendix_success_criterion": spec,
        "changes_vs_suite_task": changes,
        "criteria": criteria,
        "physics_integrity": integrity,
        "pass": bool(ok),
    }
    path = Path(rig.out_dir) / "appendix_qa.json"

    def _default(o):
        if isinstance(o, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.integer):
            return int(o)
        if isinstance(o, np.floating):
            return float(o)
        raise TypeError(type(o))

    path.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=_default))
    print(f"[appendix] {task}: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} -> {path}")
    return out

## Task options

Every task's variation axes, random starts and other options are listed by `force-bench variations` and
`force-bench info <name>`, and described in [variations.md](variations.md):

```bash
force-bench run plug_in_charger_block1 --set "Insertion force=0.85mm"   # a variation value, by its website label
force-bench run turn_dial_to_target --set "Target position=45"           # another target
force-bench run plug_in_usb_1 --seed 2                                   # a random start
force-bench run retrieve_utensil_from_bin --embodiment finray            # other fingers (embodiments.md)
force-bench run plug_in_ethernet --port 3                                # an option of the task itself
```

A run with `--set`, `--seed` or `--embodiment` writes to its own folder, `outputs/appendix_tasks/<name>__<choices>/`,
so it never overwrites the row's default run. `--name <folder>` or `TB_OUT_ROOT=<dir>` chooses another place.
